generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be an agency/contractor of who have carried out Supply & installation /Repair/AMC of Computers and their equipments in any industry/utility in India. In proof of this, intending bidder shall produce at least one scanned copy of work order and work done certificate/work completion certificate/installation report of value not less than 0.83 Lakhs in previous five years issued from competent authority. Work done/work completion certificate/installation report of previous years will be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of financial year of tender invited

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have an average financial turnover of more than 1.66 Lakhs value during last any Two years in preceding 5 financial years and should furnish scanned copy of turnover certificate duly certified by Charted Accountant. Financial turnover of previous year will be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of financial year of tender invited
